title.raw: 卷十三 本紀第十三: 世祖十 Volume 13 Annals 13: Shizu 10

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月乙卯，帝御大明殿，右丞相和禮霍孫率百官奉玉冊玉寶，上尊號曰憲天述道仁文義武大光孝皇帝，諸王百官朝賀如朔旦儀，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on yimao day, the Emperor took the throne at Great Brightness Hall; right grand councillor Huluhuosun led all officials in presenting jade registers and jade seals, offering the honorific title Emperor of Observing Heaven and Expounding the Way, Humaneness, Culture, Righteousness, Martial Grandeur, and Great Filial Brightness; princes and officials offered congratulations according to the new-moon morning ceremony; an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, the Emperor took the throne in Great Brightness Hall. Right grand councillor Huluhuosun led all officials in presenting jade registers and seals and offering the honorific title Emperor of Observing Heaven and Expounding the Way, Humaneness, Culture, Righteousness, Martial Grandeur, and Great Filial Brightness. Princes and officials offered congratulations as on a new-moon morning, and an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕：「自今凡奏事者，必先語同列以所奏。

translations.literal: On dingsi day an edict said: "From now on, whoever memorializes must first tell his colleagues what is to be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict said, "From now on, whoever memorializes must first tell his colleagues what is to be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 既奏，其所奉旨云何，令同列知而後書之簿；

translations.literal: After memorializing, what imperial rescript was received must be made known to colleagues before it is written in the register;
translations.idiomatic: After memorializing, whatever imperial rescript was received must be made known to colleagues before it is written in the register;

sentences.zh: 不明以告而輒書簿者，杖必阇赤。

translations.literal: whoever writes in the register without clearly informing others shall be flogged by the bichur guards."
translations.idiomatic: whoever writes in the register without clearly informing others shall be flogged by the bichur guards."

sentences.zh: 」己未，罷雲南都元帥府，所管軍民隸行省。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the Yunnan chief marshal command was abolished; its military and civilian population was placed under the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Yunnan chief marshal command was abolished, and its military and civilian population was placed under the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷揚州等處理算官，以其事付行省。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the auditing officials of Yangzhou and other places were abolished; the matter was transferred to the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the auditing officials of Yangzhou and other places were abolished, and the matter was transferred to the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 江浙行省平章忙忽帶進真珠百斤。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor Manghudai presented one hundred jin of pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Manghudai presented 100 jin of pearls.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，闊闊你敦言：「屯田芍陂兵二千，布種二千石，得粳糯二萬五千石有奇，乞增新附軍二千。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Kuoniyadun said: "Two thousand troops garrison-farming at Shaobo Pond were sown with two thousand shi of seed; the harvest was more than twenty-five thousand shi of long- and glutinous-grain rice; I ask to add two thousand newly submitted troops."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Kuoniyadun said, "Two thousand troops garrison-farming at Shaobo Pond were sown with 2,000 shi of seed and harvested more than 25,000 shi of long- and glutinous-grain rice; I ask to add 2,000 newly submitted troops."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，建都王、烏蒙及金齒一十二處俱降。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Prince of Jiandu, Wumeng, and twelve places including Jinchi all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Prince of Jiandu, Wumeng, and twelve places including Jinchi all submitted.

sentences.zh: 建都先為緬所制，欲降未能。

translations.literal: Jiandu had first been controlled by Burma and wished to submit but could not.
translations.idiomatic: Jiandu had first been controlled by Burma and wished to submit but could not.

sentences.zh: 時諸王相吾答兒及行省右丞太卜、參知政事也罕的斤分道征緬，於阿昔、阿禾兩江造船二百艘，順流攻之，拔江頭城，令都元帥袁世安戍之。

translations.literal: At this time Prince Xiangwudaer together with branch secretariat right vice censor Da Bu and associate administrator Yehan Dejin campaigned against Burma by separate routes; at the Axi and Ahe rivers they built two hundred boats, attacked downstream, took Jiangtou City, and ordered commander-in-chief Yuan Shi'an to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Prince Xiangwudaer, branch secretariat right vice censor Da Bu, and associate administrator Yehan Dejin campaigned against Burma by separate routes. At the Axi and Ahe rivers they built 200 boats, attacked downstream, took Jiangtou City, and ordered commander-in-chief Yuan Shi'an to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 遂遣使招諭緬王，不應。

translations.literal: Envoys were then dispatched to summon and instruct the king of Burma; he did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were then sent to summon and instruct the king of Burma; he did not respond.

sentences.zh: 建都太公城乃其巢穴，遂水陸並進，攻太公城，拔之，故至是皆降。

translations.literal: Taigong City of Jiandu was their stronghold; government forces then advanced by land and water, attacked Taigong City, took it, and hence at this time all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taigong City of Jiandu was their stronghold. Government forces advanced by land and water, attacked Taigong City, took it, and hence all now submitted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，立江淮、荊湖、江西、四川行樞密院，治建康、鄂州、撫州、成都。

translations.literal: On gengwu day traveling privy councils for Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, Jiangxi, and Sichuan were established, based at Jiankang, Ezhou, Fuzhou, and Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day traveling privy councils for Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, Jiangxi, and Sichuan were established at Jiankang, Ezhou, Fuzhou, and Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 立耽羅國安撫司。

translations.literal: The Tamna Kingdom pacification commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Tamna Kingdom pacification commission was established.

sentences.zh: 辛未，相吾答兒遣使進緬國所貢珍珠、珊瑚、異彩及七寶束帶。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Xiangwudaer dispatched envoys to present pearls, coral, exotic silks, and seven-treasure belts offered by Burma.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Xiangwudaer sent envoys to present pearls, coral, exotic silks, and seven-treasure belts offered by Burma.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣蒙古官及翰林院官各一人祠嶽瀆后土。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day one Mongol official and one Hanlin Academy official were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day one Mongol official and one Hanlin Academy official were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar.

sentences.zh: 遣王積翁賫詔使日本，賜錦衣、玉環、鞍轡。

translations.literal: Wang Jiweng was dispatched bearing an edict as envoy to Japan and granted brocade robes, jade rings, and saddle gear.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jiweng was dispatched bearing an edict as envoy to Japan and granted brocade robes, jade rings, and saddle gear.

sentences.zh: 積翁由慶元航海至日本近境，為舟人所害。

translations.literal: Jiweng sailed from Qingyuan by sea to the vicinity of Japan and was killed by boatmen.
translations.idiomatic: Jiweng sailed from Qingyuan by sea to the vicinity of Japan and was killed by boatmen.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「罪黜之人，久忘其名又復奏用，乞戒約。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "Persons dismissed for crime are long forgotten by name yet again memorialized for employment; we ask that this be forbidden and regulated.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Persons dismissed for crime are long forgotten by name yet again memorialized for employment; we ask that this be forbidden and regulated.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「卿等所言固是，然其間豈無罪輕可錄用者？

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is indeed right, yet are there not among them some whose offenses were light and who may be employed?
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is indeed right, yet are there not among them some whose offenses were light and who may be employed?

sentences.zh: 」御史大夫玉速帖木兒對曰：「以各人所犯罪狀明白敷奏，用否當取聖裁。

translations.literal: " Censor-in-chief Yusutemür replied: "Let each person's criminal circumstances be clearly set forth in memorial; whether to employ them should await imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: " Censor-in-chief Yusutemür replied, "Let each person's criminal circumstances be clearly set forth in memorial; whether to employ them should await imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙子，建寧叛賊黃華自殺。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the Jianning rebel Huang Hua killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Jianning rebel Huang Hua killed himself.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雲南諸路按察司官陛辭，詔諭之曰：「卿至彼，當宣明朕意，勿求貨財，名成則貨財隨之，徇財則必失其名，而性命亦不可保矣。

translations.literal: On dingchou day surveillance officials of the various Yunnan routes had farewell audience at court; an edict instructed them: "When you arrive there, you must clearly announce my intent: do not seek goods and wealth; when reputation is established goods and wealth follow; if you pursue wealth you will surely lose your reputation, and your lives also cannot be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day surveillance officials of the various Yunnan routes had farewell audience at court. An edict instructed them, "When you arrive there, clearly announce my intent: do not seek goods and wealth. When reputation is established, goods and wealth follow; if you pursue wealth you will surely lose your reputation, and your lives also cannot be preserved."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，馬八兒國遣使貢珍珠、異寶、縑段。

translations.literal: On jimao day the kingdom of Ma-ba dispatched envoys to offer pearls, exotic treasures, and silk cloth as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the kingdom of Ma-ba dispatched envoys to offer pearls, exotic treasures, and silk cloth as tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，以福建宣慰使管如德為泉州行省參知政事，征緬。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinsi day, Fujian pacification commissioner Guan Rude was made associate administrator of the Quanzhou branch secretariat to campaign against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi day, Fujian pacification commissioner Guan Rude was made associate administrator of the Quanzhou branch secretariat to campaign against Burma.

sentences.zh: 浚揚州漕河。

translations.literal: The Yangzhou canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 罷高麗造征日本船。

translations.literal: The building of Japan expedition ships by Goryeo was halted.
translations.idiomatic: The building of Japan expedition ships by Goryeo was halted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命翰林學士承旨撒裏蠻祀先農於籍田。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Sariman was ordered to sacrifice to the First Farmer at the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Sariman was ordered to sacrifice to the First Farmer at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以江西叛寇妻子賜鷹坊養虎者。

translations.literal: On renchen day the wives and children of Jiangxi rebel bandits were granted to the hawk office keepers of tigers.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the wives and children of Jiangxi rebel bandits were granted to the hawk office keepers of tigers.

sentences.zh: 以別速帶逃軍七百餘人付安西王屯田，給以牛具。

translations.literal: More than seven hundred deserting troops under Biesudai were assigned to the Prince of Anxi for garrison-farming and given oxen and implements.
translations.idiomatic: More than 700 deserting troops under Biesudai were assigned to the Prince of Anxi for garrison-farming and given oxen and implements.

sentences.zh: 邕州、賓州民黃大成等叛，梧州、韶州、衡州民相挻而起，湖南宣慰使撒裏蠻將兵討之。

translations.literal: Commoners Huang Dacheng and others of Yongzhou and Binzhou rebelled; commoners of Wuzhou, Shaozhou, and Hengzhou rose one after another; Hunan pacification commissioner Sariman led troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners Huang Dacheng and others of Yongzhou and Binzhou rebelled, and commoners of Wuzhou, Shaozhou, and Hengzhou rose one after another. Hunan pacification commissioner Sariman led troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷群牧所。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the herd pasturage offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the herd pasturage offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，瑞州獲叛民晏順等三十二人，並妻孥送京師。

translations.literal: On jihai day Ruizhou captured thirty-two rebel commoners including Yan Shun, together with their wives and children, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Ruizhou captured 32 rebel commoners including Yan Shun, together with their wives and children, and sent them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 罷阿八赤開河之役，以其軍及水手各萬人運海道糧。

translations.literal: Abaqchi's river-opening project was halted; his army and ten thousand sailors each were assigned to transport grain by sea route.
translations.idiomatic: Abaqchi's river-opening project was halted; his army and 10,000 sailors each were assigned to transport grain by sea route.

sentences.zh: 放檀州淘金五百人還家。

translations.literal: Five hundred gold-washers of Tanzhou were released to return home.
translations.idiomatic: 500 gold-washers of Tanzhou were released to return home.

sentences.zh: 丁未，括江南樂工。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Jiangnan musicians were registered and levied.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jiangnan musicians were registered and levied.

sentences.zh: 命阿塔海發兵萬五千人、船二百艘助征占城，船不足，命江西省益之。

translations.literal: Atahai was ordered to dispatch fifteen thousand troops and two hundred ships to assist the campaign against Champa; ships were insufficient and Jiangxi Province was ordered to supply more.
translations.idiomatic: Atahai was ordered to dispatch 15,000 troops and 200 ships to assist the campaign against Champa; ships were insufficient and Jiangxi Province was ordered to supply more.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徙江淮行省於杭州，徙浙西宣慰司於平江，省黃州宣慰司入淮西道。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat was moved to Hangzhou; the Zhe-xi pacification commission was moved to Pingjiang; the Huangzhou pacification commission was abolished and merged into the Huai-xi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat was moved to Hangzhou, the Zhe-xi pacification commission to Pingjiang, and the Huangzhou pacification commission was abolished and merged into the Huai-xi circuit.

sentences.zh: 立法輪竿於大內萬壽山，高百尺。

translations.literal: A dharma wheel pillar was erected at Longevity Mountain within the palace precinct, one hundred chi high.
translations.idiomatic: A dharma wheel pillar was erected at Longevity Mountain within the palace precinct, 100 chi high.

sentences.zh: 漳州盜起，命江浙行省調兵進討。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Zhangzhou; the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to mobilize troops to advance and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Zhangzhou; the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat was ordered to mobilize troops to advance and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 秦州總管劉發有罪，嘗欲歸黃華，事覺伏誅，遷故宋宗室及其大臣之仕者於內地。

translations.literal: Qinzhou prefect Liu Fa was guilty; he had wished to join Huang Hua; when the affair was discovered he was executed; former Song imperial clan members and ministers who had entered service were moved to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou prefect Liu Fa was guilty; he had wished to join Huang Hua. When the affair was discovered he was executed, and former Song imperial clan members and ministers who had entered service were moved to the interior.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，敕思、播管軍民官自今勿遷。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinhai day, an edict directed that officials managing military and civilians in Si and Bo circuits from now on should not be transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai day, an edict directed that officials managing military and civilians in Si and Bo circuits should not be transferred from now on.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，皇子北平王南木合至自北邊。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the imperial son, Prince of Beiping Namuhe, arrived from the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the imperial son, Prince of Beiping Namuhe, arrived from the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 王以至元八年建幕庭於和林北野裏麻裏之地，留七年，至是始歸，右丞相安童繼至。

translations.literal: The prince had in the eighth year of Zhiyuan built a camp at Alimali north of Karakorum, remained seven years, and only now returned; right grand councillor An Tong arrived afterward.
translations.idiomatic: The prince had in the eighth year of Zhiyuan built a camp at Alimali north of Karakorum, remained seven years, and only now returned; right grand councillor An Tong arrived afterward.

sentences.zh: 以張弘範等將新附軍。

translations.literal: Zhang Hongfan and others were placed in command of newly submitted troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongfan and others were placed in command of newly submitted troops.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，更定虎符。

translations.literal: On renxu day tiger tallies were redesigned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day tiger tallies were redesigned.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，乘輿幸上都。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the imperial carriage traveled to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the imperial carriage traveled to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太廟正殿成，奉安神主。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed and spirit tablets were installed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed and spirit tablets were installed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，置潮、贛、吉、撫、建昌戍兵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day garrison troops were placed at Chao, Gan, Ji, Fu, and Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day garrison troops were placed at Chao, Gan, Ji, Fu, and Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，高麗國王王春以皇帝尊號禮成，遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On yihai day King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because the ceremony for the Emperor's honorific title was completed, dispatched envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because the ceremony for the Emperor's honorific title was completed, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，令軍民同築堤堰，以利五衛屯田。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renwu day, military and civilians were ordered jointly to build dikes and dams to benefit the five guards' garrison fields.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renwu day, military and civilians were ordered jointly to build dikes and dams to benefit the five guards' garrison fields.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，省泉府司入戶部，立大都留守司兼少府監，立大都路總管府，立西川、延安、鳳翔、興元宣課司。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Treasury Bureau was abolished and merged into the Ministry of Revenue; the Dadu capital intendant's office concurrently managing the Palace Manufactories Directorate was established; the Dadu Route prefectural command was established; revenue commissions for West Sichuan, Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Xingyuan were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Treasury Bureau was abolished and merged into the Ministry of Revenue; the Dadu capital intendant's office concurrently managing the Palace Manufactories Directorate was established; the Dadu Route prefectural command was established; and revenue commissions for West Sichuan, Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Xingyuan were established.

sentences.zh: 從迷裏火者、蜜剌裏等言，以鈔萬錠為市於別十八里及河西、上都。

translations.literal: Following the memorials of Mirhuozhe, Misili, and others, ten thousand ingots of paper currency were assigned for markets at Bieshili, Hexi, and Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Following the memorials of Mirhuozhe, Misili, and others, 10,000 ingots of paper currency were assigned for markets at Bieshili, Hexi, and Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 以火者赤依舊揚州鹽運使，歲市鹽八十萬石以贖過。

translations.literal: Qohochi was retained as Yangzhou salt transport commissioner; eight hundred thousand shi of salt were purchased annually to atone for past offenses.
translations.idiomatic: Qohochi was retained as Yangzhou salt transport commissioner; 800,000 shi of salt were purchased annually to atone for past offenses.

sentences.zh: 己亥，涿州巨馬河決，沖突三十餘里。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Juma River at Zhuozhou burst its banks and scoured more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Juma River at Zhuozhou burst its banks and scoured more than 30 li.

sentences.zh: 庚子，湖廣行省平章阿裏海牙請身至海濱收集占城散軍，復使南征，且趣其未行者，許之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Ala Haiya asked to go in person to the seacoast to gather Champa's scattered troops, again send them south on campaign, and also urge those who had not yet departed; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor Ala Haiya asked to go in person to the seacoast to gather Champa's scattered troops, send them south again on campaign, and urge those who had not yet departed; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，江淮行省進各翼童男女百人。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat presented one hundred boys and girls from each wing.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat presented 100 boys and girls from each wing.

sentences.zh: 忽都鐵木兒征緬之師為賊沖潰。

translations.literal: Hudutemur's army campaigning against Burma was routed by bandit attack.
translations.idiomatic: Hudutemur's army campaigning against Burma was routed by bandit attack.

sentences.zh: 戊申，高麗王王春及公主以其世子謜來朝。

translations.literal: On wushen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo and the princess came to court with their heir Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo and the princess came to court with their heir Yuan.

sentences.zh: 敕發思、播田、楊二家軍二千從征緬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered two thousand troops of the Tian and Yang families of Si and Bo dispatched to join the Burma campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered 2,000 troops of the Tian and Yang families of Si and Bo dispatched to join the Burma campaign.

sentences.zh: 籍江南鹽徒軍，藏匿者有罪。

translations.literal: Jiangnan salt laborers and troops were registered; those who concealed themselves were punishable.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan salt laborers and troops were registered; those who concealed themselves were punishable.

sentences.zh: 火兒忽等所部民戶告饑，帝曰：「饑民不救，儲糧何為？

translations.literal: The households under Huo'erhu and others reported famine; the Emperor said: "If famine victims are not relieved, what are stored grains for?
translations.idiomatic: The households under Huo'erhu and others reported famine; the Emperor said, "If famine victims are not relieved, what are stored grains for?

sentences.zh: 」發萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Ten thousand shi were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 shi were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 命開元等路宣慰司造船百艘，付狗國戍軍。

translations.literal: The Kaiyuan and other routes pacification commission was ordered to build one hundred boats and assign them to the Gou Kingdom garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan and other routes pacification commission was ordered to build 100 boats and assign them to the Gou Kingdom garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 雲南行省為破緬國江頭城，進童男女八十人，並銀器幣帛。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Hanlin Academician Sariman and Hanlin and Academy Grand Academician Xu Guozhen were ordered to gather medical professors from all routes to revise and enlarge the Materia Medica.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Hanlin Academician Sariman and Hanlin and Academy Grand Academician Xu Guozhen were ordered to gather medical professors from all routes to revise and enlarge the Materia Medica.

sentences.zh: 是月，鎮南王軍至安南，殺其守兵，分六道以進，安南興道王以兵拒於萬劫，進擊敗之，萬戶倪閏戰死於劉村。

translations.literal: That month Prince of Zhennan's army reached Annam, killed its garrison troops, and advanced in six columns; the Annam Prince of Xingdao resisted at Wanjie; advance troops defeated him; wanhu Ni Run died in battle at Liucun.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Zhennan's army reached Annam, killed its garrison troops, and advanced in six columns; the Annam Prince of Xingdao resisted at Wanjie; advance troops defeated him; wanhu Ni Run died in battle at Liucun.

sentences.zh: 以涇州隸都總帥府、賜蒙古貧乏者兀馬兒等鈔二千八百八十五錠、銀四十錠。

translations.literal: Jing Prefecture was placed under the Chief Commanderate and paper currency of two thousand eight hundred eighty-five ingots and forty ingots of silver were granted to the impoverished Mongol Wumaer and others.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Prefecture was placed under the chief commanderate and 2,885 ingots of paper currency and 40 ingots of silver were granted to the impoverished Mongol Wumaer and others.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月戊寅，以命相詔天下。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, spring, first month, on wuyin day an edict announcing the appointment of chancellors was issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on wuyin day of the first month of spring, an edict announcing the appointment of chancellors was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 民間買賣金銀、懷孟諸路竹貨、江淮以南江河魚利，皆弛其禁。

translations.literal: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, bamboo goods of the Huaimeng routes, and river and lake fishing profits south of the Yangzi and Huai were all relaxed from prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, bamboo goods of the Huaimeng routes, and river and lake fishing profits south of the Yangzi and Huai were all relaxed from prohibition.

sentences.zh: 諸處站赤飲食，官為支給。

translations.literal: Food and drink at relay stations everywhere was supplied by the state.
translations.idiomatic: Food and drink at relay stations everywhere was supplied by the state.

sentences.zh: 遣官諸路慮囚，罪輕者釋之。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched on all routes to review prisoners; those guilty of light offenses were released.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched on all routes to review prisoners; those guilty of light offenses were released.

sentences.zh: 徙屯衛輝新附軍六千家，廩之京師，以完倉廩。

translations.literal: Six thousand households of newly submitted troops garrisoned at Weihui were moved, provisioned at the capital, to fill the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: 6,000 households of newly submitted troops garrisoned at Weihui were moved, provisioned at the capital, to fill the granaries.

sentences.zh: 發五衛軍及新附軍浚蒙村漕渠。

translations.literal: The five guard armies and newly submitted troops were dispatched to dredge the Mengcun canal.
translations.idiomatic: The five guard armies and newly submitted troops were sent to dredge the canal at Mengcun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，立別十八里驛傳。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the Bieshili courier relay was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Bieshili courier relay was established.

sentences.zh: 毀宋郊天臺。

translations.literal: The Song suburban altar terrace was demolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Song suburban altar terrace was demolished.

sentences.zh: 桑哥言：「楊璉真加雲，會稽有泰寧寺，宋毀之以建寧宗等攢宮；

translations.literal: Sangge said: "Yang Lianzhenjia says that in Kuaiji there is Taining Monastery; the Song demolished it to build the temporary mausoleum for Emperor Ningzong and others;
translations.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Yang Lianzhenjia says that Kuaiji has Taining Monastery, which the Song demolished to build the temporary mausoleum for Emperor Ningzong and others;

sentences.zh: 錢唐有龍華寺，宋毀之以為南郊。

translations.literal: Qiantang has Longhua Monastery; the Song demolished it for the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: Qiantang has Longhua Monastery, which the Song demolished for the southern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 皆勝地也，宜復為寺，以為皇上、東宮祈壽。

translations.literal: Both are fine sites and should be restored as monasteries to pray for long life for the Emperor and the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Both are fine sites and should be restored as monasteries to pray for the long life of the Emperor and the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 」時寧宗等攢宮已毀建寺，敕毀郊天臺，亦建寺焉。

translations.literal: " At this time the temporary mausoleum for Ningzong and others had already been demolished and a monastery built; an edict ordered the suburban altar terrace demolished and a monastery built there as well.
translations.idiomatic: " By then the temporary mausoleum for Ningzong and others had already been demolished and a monastery built; an edict ordered the suburban altar terrace demolished and a monastery built there as well.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔立市舶都轉運司。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered establishment of the Maritime Trade General Transport Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict established the maritime trade general transport bureau.

sentences.zh: 立上都等路群牧都轉運使司、諸路常平鹽鐵坑冶都轉運司。

translations.literal: The Shangdu and other routes Pasture General Transport Commission and the Various Routes Ever-Normal Salt, Iron, Mining, and Smelting General Transport Commission were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangdu and other routes pasture general transport commission and the various routes ever-normal salt, iron, mining, and smelting general transport commission were established.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣使代祀五嶽、四瀆、東海、后土。

translations.literal: On jiashen day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice on the Emperor's behalf at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 戊子，闊闊你敦言：「先有旨遣軍二千屯田芍陂，試土之肥磽，去秋已收米二萬餘石，請增屯士二千人。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Kuoniyadun said: "There was an earlier order to dispatch two thousand troops to garrison-farm at Shaobo Pond; testing the soil's fertility and barrenness, last autumn more than twenty thousand shi of rice were harvested; I ask to add two thousand garrison-farming soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Kuoniyadun said, "An earlier order had dispatched 2,000 troops to garrison-farm at Shaobo Pond; after testing the soil's fertility, last autumn more than 20,000 shi of rice were harvested; I ask to add 2,000 garrison-farming soldiers.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 徙江南樂工八百家於京師。

translations.literal: Eight hundred Jiangnan musicians were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: 800 Jiangnan musicians were moved to the capital.

sentences.zh: 封駙馬唆郎哥為寧昌郡王，賜龜紐銀印。

translations.literal: The imperial son-in-law Suolangge was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningchang Commandery and granted a silver seal with tortoise knob.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Suolangge was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningchang Commandery and granted a silver seal with tortoise knob.

sentences.zh: 西川趙和尚自稱宋福王子廣王以誑民，民有信者；

translations.literal: In West Sichuan the monk Zhao claimed to be Prince Guang, son of Song Emperor Fuzong, to deceive the people, and some believed him;
translations.idiomatic: In West Sichuan a monk Zhao claimed to be Prince Guang, son of Song Emperor Fuzong, to deceive the people, and some believed him;

sentences.zh: 真定民劉驢兒有三乳，自以為異，謀不軌；

translations.literal: In Zhending a commoner Liu Lu'er had three nipples and regarded it as a prodigy, plotting sedition;
translations.idiomatic: In Zhending a commoner Liu Lu'er had three nipples, took it as a portent, and plotted sedition;

sentences.zh: 事覺，皆磔裂以徇。

translations.literal: When the matters were discovered, all were torn apart by dismemberment and displayed as warning.
translations.idiomatic: When the plots were discovered, all were torn apart and displayed as warning.

sentences.zh: 移五條河屯田軍五百於兀失蠻、劄失蠻。

translations.literal: Five hundred garrison-farming troops of Wutiao River were moved to Ushiman and Zhashiman.
translations.idiomatic: 500 Wutiao River garrison-farming troops were moved to Ushiman and Zhashiman.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，發諸衛軍六千八百人給護國寺修造。

translations.literal: On xinmao day six thousand eight hundred guard troops were dispatched to supply the Huoguo Monastery renovation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day 6,800 guard troops were dispatched for Huoguo Monastery renovation.

sentences.zh: 廣御史臺贓罰庫。

translations.literal: The Censorate confiscation and fine treasury was expanded.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate confiscation and fine treasury was expanded.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，樞密臣言：「舊制四宿衛各選一人參決樞密院事，請以脫列伯為僉院。

translations.literal: On guisi day Privy Council officials said: "Under the old system each of the four guard corps selected one man to participate in deciding Privy Council affairs; we ask that Teliebo be made vice administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day privy council officials said, "Under the old system each of the four guard corps selected one man to participate in deciding privy council affairs; we ask that Teliebo be made vice administrator.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 詔括京師荒地，令宿衛士耕種。

translations.literal: An edict ordered vacant land in the capital surveyed and guard soldiers put to farming it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered vacant land in the capital surveyed and guard soldiers assigned to farm it.

sentences.zh: 乙未，中書省臣請以御史大夫玉速怗，木兒為左丞相，中書丞裏蠻為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials asked that censor-in-chief Yusutemür be made left chief councillor and Central Secretariat associate Liman be made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day central secretariat officials asked that censor-in-chief Yusutemür be made left chief councillor and secretariat associate Liman censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 罷行御史臺，以其所屬按察司隸御史臺，行御史臺大夫撥魯罕為中書省平章政事。

translations.literal: The Traveling Censorate was abolished; its subordinate surveillance commissions were placed under the Censorate; Traveling Censorate chief councillor Boruhan was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The traveling censorate was abolished, its surveillance commissions placed under the censorate, and traveling censorate chief councillor Boruhan made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「玉速帖木兒朕當思之，撥魯罕寬緩，不可。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I must think about Yusutemür; Boruhan is lax and unsuitable.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "I must think about Yusutemür; Boruhan is too lax and unsuitable.

sentences.zh: 」安童對曰：「阿必赤合何如？

translations.literal: " An Tong replied: "What about Abichige?"
translations.idiomatic: " An Tong replied, "What about Abichige?"

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此事朕自處之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "I will handle this matter myself.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "I will handle this matter myself.

sentences.zh: 罷行御史臺者，當如所奏。

translations.literal: Abolishing the traveling censorate should proceed as submitted."
translations.idiomatic: Abolishing the traveling censorate should proceed as submitted."

sentences.zh: 」盧世榮請罷福建行中書省，立宣慰司，隸江西行中書省。

translations.literal: Lu Shirong asked to abolish the Fujian Branch Secretariat, establish a pacification commission, and place it under the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong asked to abolish the Fujian branch secretariat, establish a pacification commission, and place it under the Jiangxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 又言：「江南行中書省事繁，恐致壅滯，今隨行省立行樞密院總兵，以分其務為便。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Jiangnan Branch Secretariat has too many affairs and may become congested; it would be convenient now to establish a traveling privy council alongside the branch secretariat to command troops and divide the work.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The Jiangnan branch secretariat's business is heavy and may stall; it would be convenient to establish a traveling privy council alongside the branch secretariat to command troops and divide the work.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「行院之事，前日已言，由阿合馬欲其子忽辛兼兵柄而止，今議行之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "The matter of the traveling bureau was discussed the other day; it was stopped because Ahmad wished his son Husin to hold military authority as well; now the proposal is to be carried out."
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "The traveling bureau was discussed the other day; it was stopped because Ahmad wanted his son Husin to hold military power as well; now the proposal is to be carried out."

sentences.zh: 」流征占城擅還將帥二十三人於遠方。

translations.literal: Twenty-three generals who had returned from the Champa campaign without authorization were banished to distant places.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-three generals who had returned from the Champa campaign without authorization were banished to distant places.

sentences.zh: 丙申，帝畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 升武備監為武備寺，尚醫監為太醫院，職俱三品，升六部為二品。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Military Stores was promoted to the Bureau of Military Stores, the Directorate of Palace Physicians to the Grand Medical Service; both offices were rank three; the Six Ministries were raised to rank two.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of military stores was promoted to bureau of military stores, the directorate of palace physicians to the grand medical service—both rank three—and the six ministries were raised to rank two.

sentences.zh: 以合必赤合為中書平章政事，命禮部領會同館。

translations.literal: Kebichige was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat; the Ministry of Rites was ordered to oversee the Hall of Joint Audience.
translations.idiomatic: Kebichige was made associate administrator of the central secretariat, and the Ministry of Rites was ordered to oversee the Hall of Joint Audience.

sentences.zh: 初，外國使至，常令翰林院主之，至是改正。

translations.literal: At first when foreign envoys arrived they were usually handled by the Hanlin Academy; at this time this was corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly foreign envoys were usually handled by the Hanlin Academy; that arrangement was now changed.

sentences.zh: 荊湖占城行省平叛蠻百六十六洞。

translations.literal: The Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat pacified one hundred sixty-six rebel Man cave communities.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat pacified 166 rebel Man cave communities.

sentences.zh: 詔禁私酒。

translations.literal: An edict prohibited illicit wine.
translations.idiomatic: An edict prohibited private distillation of wine.

sentences.zh: 己亥，分江浙行省所治南康隸江西省。

translations.literal: On jihai day Nanchang, under the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat's jurisdiction, was placed under Jiangxi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Nanchang, under Jiangzhe branch secretariat jurisdiction, was placed under Jiangxi Province.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以楊兀魯帶為征骨嵬招討使，佩二珠虎符。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Yang Uludai was made pacification commissioner for the Guwei campaign and granted a two-pearl tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yang Uludai was made pacification commissioner for the Guwei campaign and granted a two-pearl tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，造大樽於殿，樽以木為質，銀內而金外，鏤為雲龍，高一丈七寸。

translations.literal: On renyin day a great wine vessel was made in the hall; the vessel was of wood with silver inside and gold outside, carved with cloud-dragons, one zhang and seven cun high.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day a great wine vessel was made for the hall—wooden, silver-lined and gold-clad, carved with cloud-dragons, one zhang and seven cun high.

sentences.zh: 是月壬午，烏馬兒領兵與安南興道王遇，擊敗之，兵次富良江北。

translations.literal: That month on renwu day Umar led troops and encountered Prince Xingdao of Annam; he defeated them, and the army halted north of the Fu River.
translations.idiomatic: That month on renwu day Umar led troops and met Prince Xingdao of Annam, defeated them, and halted north of the Fu River.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，安南世子陳日烜領戰船千餘艘以拒。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Annam heir Chen Rixuan led more than one thousand warships to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Annam heir Chen Rixuan led more than 1,000 warships to resist.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，與戰，大破之，日烜遁去，入其城。

translations.literal: On bingxu day they joined battle and routed them; Rixuan fled and they entered his city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day they fought and routed them; Rixuan fled, and they entered the city.

sentences.zh: 還屯富良江北，唆都、唐古帶等引兵與鎮南王會。

translations.literal: They returned to encamp north of the Fu River; Suodu, Tangudai, and others led troops to join the Prince of Zhennan.
translations.idiomatic: They returned to encamp north of the Fu River; Suodu, Tangudai, and others led troops to join the Prince of Zhennan.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，駐蹕柳林。

translations.literal: Second month, on yisi day, the imperial carriage halted at Willow Grove.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi day, the imperial carriage halted at Willow Grove.

sentences.zh: 增濟州漕舟三千艘，役夫萬二千人。

translations.literal: Three thousand transport vessels of Jizhou were added; twelve thousand corvee laborers were assigned.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou's transport fleet was increased by 3,000 vessels, with 12,000 corvee laborers assigned.

sentences.zh: 初，江淮歲漕米百萬石於京師，海運十萬石，膠、萊六十萬石，而濟之所運三十萬石，水淺舟大，恒不能達，更以百石之舟，舟用四人，故夫數增多。

translations.literal: At first Huai-Jiang annually transported one million shi of grain to the capital by canal: one hundred thousand shi by sea, six hundred thousand shi via Jiao and Lai, and three hundred thousand shi via Ji; the water was shallow and the boats large, so they often could not reach destination; boats of one hundred shi were substituted, each boat using four men, hence corvee numbers increased.
translations.idiomatic: At first Huai-Jiang annually transported 1 million shi of grain to the capital: 100,000 shi by sea, 600,000 via Jiao and Lai, and 300,000 via Ji; the water was too shallow for large boats, so 100-shi boats were substituted, each needing four men, and corvee numbers increased.

sentences.zh: 塞渾河堤決，役夫四千人。

translations.literal: A breach in the Hun River dike was closed; four thousand corvee laborers were employed.
translations.idiomatic: A breach in the Hun River dike was closed with 4,000 corvee laborers.

sentences.zh: 詔改江淮、江西元帥招討司為上中下三萬戶府，蒙古、漢人、新附諸軍相參，作三十七翼。

translations.literal: An edict changed the Huai-Jiang and Jiangxi marshal pacification commissions into upper, middle, and lower wanhu commands; Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were mixed together, forming thirty-seven wings.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the Huai-Jiang and Jiangxi marshal pacification commissions into upper, middle, and lower wanhu commands; Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were combined in 37 wings.

sentences.zh: 上萬戶：宿州、蘄縣、真定、沂郯、益都、高郵、沿海七翼；

translations.literal: Upper wanhu: seven wings—Suzhou, Qixian, Zhending, Yitai, Yidu, Gaoyou, and Coastal;
translations.idiomatic: Upper wanhu: seven wings—Suzhou, Qixian, Zhending, Yitai, Yidu, Gaoyou, and Coastal;

sentences.zh: 中萬戶：棗陽、十字路、邳州、鄧州、杭州、懷州、孟州、真州八翼；

translations.literal: Middle wanhu: eight wings—Zaoyang, Shizilu, Pizhou, Dengzhou, Hangzhou, Huaizhou, Mengzhou, and Zhenzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Middle wanhu: eight wings—Zaoyang, Shizilu, Pizhou, Dengzhou, Hangzhou, Huaizhou, Mengzhou, and Zhenzhou;

sentences.zh: 下萬戶：常州、鎮江、潁州、廬州、亳州、安慶、江陰水軍、益都新軍、湖州、淮安、壽春、揚州、泰州、弩手、保甲、處州、上都新軍、黃州、安豐、松江、鎮江水軍、建康二十二翼。

translations.literal: Lower wanhu: twenty-two wings—Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yingzhou, Luzhou, Bozhou, Anqing, Jiangyin Naval Force, Yidu New Army, Huzhou, Huai'an, Shouchun, Yangzhou, Taizhou, Crossbowmen, Baojia, Chuzhou, Shangdu New Army, Huangzhou, Anfeng, Songjiang, Zhenjiang Naval Force, and Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Lower wanhu: 22 wings—Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yingzhou, Luzhou, Bozhou, Anqing, Jiangyin Naval Force, Yidu New Army, Huzhou, Huai'an, Shouchun, Yangzhou, Taizhou, Crossbowmen, Baojia, Chuzhou, Shangdu New Army, Huangzhou, Anfeng, Songjiang, Zhenjiang Naval Force, and Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 翼設達魯花赤、萬戶、副萬戶各一人，以隸所在行院。

translations.literal: Each wing had one darughachi, one wanhu, and one vice wanhu, placed under the local traveling bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Each wing had one darughachi, one wanhu, and one vice wanhu, placed under the local traveling bureau.

sentences.zh: 江西盜黎德等余黨悉平。

translations.literal: The remaining followers of Jiangxi bandit Li De and others were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining followers of the Jiangxi bandit Li De were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 以應放還五衛軍穿河西務河。

translations.literal: Guard troops due for rotation leave from the five guards were used to excavate the Hexiwu River.
translations.idiomatic: Guard troops from the five guards due for rotation leave were assigned to excavate the Hexiwu River.

sentences.zh: 舊例，五衛軍十人為率，七人三人，分為二番，十月放七人者還，正月復役，正月放三人者還，四月復役，更休息之。

translations.literal: Under the old rule, of every ten guard soldiers, seven and three were divided into two shifts; in the tenth month the seven on leave returned and resumed service in the first month; those three on leave from the first month returned and resumed in the fourth month, alternating rest periods.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule, every ten guard soldiers were divided into shifts of seven and three; those seven released in the tenth month returned to service in the first month, and those three released in the first month returned in the fourth month, alternating rest.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以荊湖行省所隸八番、羅甸隸西川行省，分嵐、管為二州。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Eight Fan and Luodian under the Jinghu Branch Secretariat were placed under the West Sichuan Branch Secretariat; Lan and Guan were divided into two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Eight Fan and Luodian under the Jinghu branch secretariat were placed under the West Sichuan branch secretariat, and Lan and Guan were split into two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 加封桑乾河神洪濟公為顯應洪濟公。

translations.literal: The Sanggan River god Lord Hongji was promoted to Lord Manifest Response Hongji.
translations.idiomatic: The Sanggan River god Lord Hongji was promoted to Lord Manifest Response Hongji.

sentences.zh: 己酉，為皇孫阿難答立衍福司，職四品，使、同知、副使各一員。

translations.literal: On jiyou day a Bureau of Extended Blessings was established for the imperial grandson Anandapati, rank four; one commissioner, one vice commissioner, and one deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day a bureau of extended blessings was established for imperial grandson Anandapati, rank four, with one commissioner, vice commissioner, and deputy commissioner each.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，廣東宣慰使月的迷失討潮、惠二州盜郭逢貴等四十五寨，皆平，降民萬餘戶、軍三千六百一十人，請將所獲渠帥入覲，面陳事宜，從之。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Guangdong pacification commissioner Yediemishi suppressed forty-five stockades of Chaozhou and Huizhou bandits including Guo Fenggui; all were pacified; more than ten thousand households and three thousand six hundred ten soldiers surrendered; he asked to bring the captured chieftains to court to report affairs in person; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Guangdong pacification commissioner Yediemishi suppressed 45 stockades of Chaozhou and Huizhou bandits including Guo Fenggui; more than 10,000 households and 3,610 soldiers surrendered; he asked to bring captured chieftains to court to report in person, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔罷膠、萊所鑿新河，以軍萬人隸江浙行省習水戰，萬人載江淮米泛海由利津達於京師。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict abolished the new canal excavated at Jiao and Lai; ten thousand troops were assigned to the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat for naval training, and ten thousand men transported Huai-Jiang grain by sea via Lijin to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict abolished the new canal at Jiao and Lai; 10,000 troops were assigned to the Jiangzhe branch secretariat for naval training, and 10,000 men transported Huai-Jiang grain by sea via Lijin to the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御史臺臣言：「近中書奏罷行御史臺，改按察司為提刑轉運司，俾兼錢谷，而糾彈之職廢矣。

translations.literal: On xinyou day censorate officials said: "Recently the Central Secretariat memorialized to abolish the traveling censorate, change surveillance commissions into criminal-transport commissions, have them also manage revenue and grain, and thereby the function of investigation and impeachment is abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day censorate officials said, "Recently the central secretariat memorialized to abolish the traveling censorate, change surveillance commissions into criminal-transport commissions with revenue and grain added, abandoning investigation and impeachment.

sentences.zh: 請令安童與老臣議。

translations.literal: Please have An Tong deliberate with senior ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Please have An Tong deliberate with senior ministers."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: On renxu day the moon transited the Heart asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transited the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣盧世榮請立規措所，經營錢谷，秩五品，所用官吏以善賈為之，勿限白身人，帝從之。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat official Lu Shirong asked to establish a planning bureau to manage revenue and grain, rank five; officials used should be skilled in trade, not limited to those without office rank; the Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat official Lu Shirong asked to establish a planning bureau to manage revenue and grain, rank five, staffed by skilled traders without rank restrictions; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 參知政事不魯迷失海牙等因奏世榮姻黨有牛姓者，前為提舉，今浙西運司課程頗多，擬升轉運副使，亦從之。

translations.literal: Associate administrator Buluosimishihaiya and others then memorialized that among Lu Shirong's affinal kin was one surnamed Niu, formerly intendant; now the Zhexi transport commission's revenue was considerable and he was proposed for promotion to vice transport commissioner; this was also approved.
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrator Buluosimishihaiya and others then memorialized that Lu Shirong's affinal kinsman Niu, formerly an intendant, was proposed as Zhexi transport vice commissioner given rising revenue; this was also approved.

sentences.zh: 詔舊城居民之遷京城者，以貲高及居職者為先，仍定制以地八畝為一分；

translations.literal: An edict ordered that residents of the old city moving to the capital should have priority by wealth and office-holding; a rule was also set that eight mu of land constituted one share;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that old-city residents moving to the capital be prioritized by wealth and office, with eight mu of land set as one share;

sentences.zh: 其或地過八畝及力不能作室者，皆不得冒據，聽民作室。

translations.literal: If land exceeded eight mu or one lacked strength to build a dwelling, none might falsely claim it; commoners were allowed to build dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone holding more than eight mu or unable to build a dwelling could not falsely claim land; commoners were allowed to build.

sentences.zh: 升禦帶庫為章佩監。

translations.literal: The Imperial Belt Store was promoted to the Bureau of Insignia and Girdle Pendants.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial belt store was promoted to the bureau of insignia and girdle pendants.

sentences.zh: 徙右千戶只兒海迷失分地泉州。

translations.literal: Right chiliarch Zhierhaimishi's apportioned land was moved to Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The apportioned land of right chiliarch Zhierhaimishi was moved to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賜合剌失都兒新附民五千戶，合剌赤、阿速、阿塔赤、昔寶赤、貴由赤等嘗從征者，亦皆賜之。

translations.literal: Five thousand newly submitted households were granted to Qaljasudar; Qalchi, Asud, Atachi, Sibachi, Guichid, and others who had once gone on campaign were also all granted households.
translations.idiomatic: 5,000 newly submitted households were granted to Qaljasudar; Qalchi, Asud, Atachi, Sibachi, Guichid, and others who had campaigned were also granted households.

sentences.zh: 以民八十戶賜皇太子宿衛臣嘗從征者。

translations.literal: Eighty households were granted to crown prince guard officers who had once gone on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: 80 households were granted to crown prince guard officers who had campaigned.

sentences.zh: 用盧世榮言，回買江南民土田。

translations.literal: Following Lu Shirong's proposal, Jiangnan commoners' land was purchased back by the state.
translations.idiomatic: Following Lu Shirong's proposal, Jiangnan commoners' land was bought back by the state.

sentences.zh: 詔天下拘收銅錢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered copper cash confiscated empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered copper cash confiscated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 申禁私造酒曲。

translations.literal: Private manufacture of brewing malt was again prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Private manufacture of brewing malt was again prohibited.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 帝問省臣：「行御史臺何故罷之？

translations.literal: The Emperor asked secretariat officials: "Why was the traveling censorate abolished?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked secretariat officials, "Why was the traveling censorate abolished?

sentences.zh: 」安童曰：「江南盜賊屢起，行御史臺鎮遏居多，臣以為不可罷。

translations.literal: " An Tong said: "Bandits have repeatedly risen in Jiangnan; the traveling censorate has chiefly checked them; I hold it should not be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " An Tong said, "Bandits have repeatedly risen in Jiangnan; the traveling censorate has chiefly checked them; I hold it should not be abolished.

sentences.zh: 然與江浙行中書省並在杭州，地甚遠僻，徙之江州，居江浙、湖南、江西三省之中為便。

translations.literal: Yet it is together with the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat in Hangzhou, a very remote place; moving it to Jiangzhou, centered among Jiangzhe, Hunan, and Jiangxi provinces, would be convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Yet it sits together with the Jiangzhe branch secretariat in Hangzhou, a very remote spot; moving it to Jiangzhou, centered among Jiangzhe, Hunan, and Jiangxi, would be convenient."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 立真定、濟南、太原、甘肅、江西、江淮、湖廣等處宜慰司兼都轉運使司，以治課程，仍立條制。

translations.literal: Pacification commissions also serving as general transport commissions were established at Zhending, Jinan, Taiyuan, Gansu, Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, Huguang, and other places to administer revenue; regulations were also established.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissions also serving as general transport commissions were established at Zhending, Jinan, Taiyuan, Gansu, Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, Huguang, and other places to administer revenue, and regulations were also established.

sentences.zh: 禁諸司不得擅追管課官吏，有敢沮擾者，具姓名以聞。

translations.literal: All offices were forbidden to summon revenue officials without authorization; anyone who dared obstruct was to report names.
translations.idiomatic: All offices were forbidden to summon revenue officials without authorization; anyone who obstructed was to report names.

sentences.zh: 增濟州漕運司軍萬二千人。

translations.literal: The Jizhou grain transport commission's soldiers were increased by twelve thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou grain transport commission troops were increased by 12,000.

sentences.zh: 立江西、江淮、湖廣造船提舉司。

translations.literal: Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, and Huguang shipbuilding intendant commissions were established.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, and Huguang shipbuilding intendant commissions were established.

sentences.zh: 令江浙行省參政馮珪，湖廣行省右丞要束木、參政潘傑，龍興行省左丞伯顏、參政楊居寬、簽省陳文福，專領課程事。

translations.literal: Feng Gui, Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator; Huguang Branch Secretariat right associate Yaosumu and associate Pan Jie; Longxing Branch Secretariat left associate Bayan, associate Yang Jukuan, and secretariat secretary Chen Wenfu were ordered to oversee revenue affairs exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Gui of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Huguang right associate Yaosumu and associate Pan Jie, and Longxing left associate Bayan, associate Yang Jukuan, and secretariat secretary Chen Wenfu were ordered to oversee revenue exclusively.

sentences.zh: 以甕吉剌帶為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: Önggiradai was made left chief councillor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Önggiradai was made left chief councillor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復立按察司。

translations.literal: On jisi day surveillance commissions were reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day surveillance commissions were reestablished.

sentences.zh: 撥民二萬七千戶與駙馬唆郎哥。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven thousand households were assigned to imperial son-in-law Suolangge.
translations.idiomatic: 27,000 households were assigned to imperial son-in-law Suolangge.

sentences.zh: 以忽都魯為平章政事。

translations.literal: Qutluq was made associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Qutluq was made associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 詔：「各道提刑按察司，能遵奉條畫，蒞事有成者，任滿升職，贓汙不稱任者，罷黜除名。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "For each circuit's criminal-surveillance commission, those who can observe regulations and succeed in their duties shall be promoted when terms expire; those corrupt and unfit shall be dismissed and stricken from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "On each circuit's criminal-surveillance commission, those who observe regulations and succeed shall be promoted at term's end; the corrupt and unfit shall be dismissed and stricken from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 」詔立供膳司，職從五品，達魯花赤、令、丞各一員。

translations.literal: " An edict also established the Provision Bureau, rank five, with one darughachi, one director, and one vice director each.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict also established the provision bureau, rank five, with one darughachi, director, and vice director each.

sentences.zh: 罷融州總管府為州。

translations.literal: Rongzhou general administration prefecture was reduced to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzhou general administration prefecture was reduced to a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，遣太史監候張公禮、彭質等往占城測候日晷。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingzi day, Astronomical Bureau observers Zhang Gongli, Peng Zhi, and others were dispatched to Champa to observe the sundial.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi day, astronomical bureau observers Zhang Gongli, Peng Zhi, and others were sent to Champa to observe the sundial.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷甘州行中書省，立宣慰司，隸寧夏行中書省。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the Ganzhou Branch Secretariat was abolished, a pacification commission established, and placed under the Ningxia Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Ganzhou branch secretariat was abolished, a pacification commission established, and placed under the Ningxia branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 荊湖占城行省請益兵，時陳日烜所逃天長、長安二處兵力復集，興道王船千餘艘聚萬劫，阮盝在永平，而官兵遠行久戰，懸處其中，唆都、唐古帶之兵又不以時至，故請益兵。

translations.literal: The Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat requested additional troops; at this time forces that Chen Rixuan had fled from at Tianchang and Chang'an had reassembled; Prince Xingdao's thousand-plus ships gathered at Wanji; Ruan'an was at Yongping; government troops had marched far and fought long, isolated in their midst; Suodu's and Tangudai's troops also did not arrive on schedule; hence additional troops were requested.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat requested reinforcements: Chen Rixuan's forces at Tianchang and Chang'an had regrouped, Prince Xingdao had more than 1,000 ships at Wanji, and Ruan'an held Yongping, while government troops fighting far from base were isolated and Suodu's and Tangudai's forces had not arrived on time.

sentences.zh: 帝以水行為危，令遵陸以往。

translations.literal: The Emperor regarded travel by water as dangerous and ordered proceeding by land.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor regarded travel by water as dangerous and ordered troops to proceed by land.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔依舊制，凡鹽一引四百斤，價銀十兩，以折今鈔為二十貫，商上都者，六十而稅一。

translations.literal: On gengzi day an edict followed the old system: each salt certificate was four hundred jin, priced at ten liang of silver, converted at the present rate to twenty guan of notes; merchants going to Shangdu paid one-sixtieth in tax.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict restored the old system: each salt certificate was 400 jin, priced at ten liang of silver or twenty guan of notes at current rates; merchants going to Shangdu paid tax at one-sixtieth.

sentences.zh: 增契本為三錢。

translations.literal: The contract deed fee was increased to three cash.
translations.idiomatic: The contract deed fee was increased to three cash.

sentences.zh: 立上都規措所回易庫，增壞鈔工墨費每貫二分為三分。

translations.literal: A planning-office exchange treasury was established at Shangdu; the worn-note replacement fee was increased from two fen to three fen per ingot.
translations.idiomatic: A planning-office exchange treasury was established at Shangdu, and the worn-note replacement fee was increased from two fen to three fen per ingot.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，立行樞密院都鎮撫司，置畏兀驛六所。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guimao day: the Mobile Privy Council Chief Pacification Office was established, and six Uighur relay stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guimao day: the Mobile Privy Council Chief Pacification Office was established, and six Uighur relay stations were set up.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以征日本船運糧江淮及教軍水戰。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, ships for the Japan expedition were used to transport grain between Jianghuai and to train troops in naval warfare.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day ships for the Japan expedition were used to transport grain between Jianghuai and to train troops in naval warfare.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，監察御史陳天祥劾中書右丞盧世榮罪惡，詔世榮、天祥皆赴上都。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, surveillance censor Chen Tianxiang impeached right vice chancellor Lu Shirong for crimes; an edict ordered both Shirong and Tianxiang to proceed to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day surveillance censor Chen Tianxiang impeached right vice chancellor Lu Shirong for crimes; an edict ordered both Shirong and Tianxiang to proceed to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，江陵民張二妻鄧氏一產三男。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Zhang Er of Jiangling's wife Dame Deng gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Zhang Er of Jiangling's wife Dame Deng gave birth to three sons at one delivery.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔追捕宋廣王及陳宜中。

translations.literal: On guichou day, an edict ordered pursuit of the Song Prince of Guang and Chen Yizhong.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered pursuit of the Song Prince of Guang and Chen Yizhong.

sentences.zh: 遣中書省、樞密院、御史臺官各一員，決大都及諸路罪囚。

translations.literal: One official each from the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate was dispatched to adjudicate criminal prisoners in Dadu and the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: One official each from the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate was dispatched to adjudicate criminal prisoners in Dadu and the various routes.

sentences.zh: 大都、汴梁、益都、廬州、河間、濟寧、歸德、保定蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts in Dadu, Bianliang, Yidu, Luzhou, Hejian, Jining, Guide, and Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Dadu, Bianliang, Yidu, Luzhou, Hejian, Jining, Guide, and Baoding.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以耽羅所造征日本船百艘賜高麗。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, one hundred Japan-expedition ships built in Tamna were granted to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day 100 Japan-expedition ships built in Tamna were granted to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御史中丞阿剌帖木兒、郭佑，侍御史白禿剌帖木兒，參知政事撒的迷失等以盧世榮所招罪狀奏。

translations.literal: On renxu day, censor-in-chief Alat'temur and Guo You, attendant censor Bai Tultemur, associate administrator Sadishimi, and others memorialized the confessed crimes of Lu Shirong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day censor-in-chief Alat'temur and Guo You, attendant censor Bai Tultemur, associate administrator Sadishimi, and others memorialized the confessed crimes of Lu Shirong.

sentences.zh: 阿剌帖木兒等與世榮對於帝前，世榮悉款服。

translations.literal: Alat'temur and the others confronted Shirong before the Emperor; Shirong fully confessed.
translations.idiomatic: Alat'temur and the others confronted Shirong before the Emperor, and Shirong fully confessed.

sentences.zh: 改六部依舊為三品。

translations.literal: The Six Ministries were restored to third rank as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Ministries were restored to third rank as before.

sentences.zh: 詔：「安童與諸老臣議世榮所行，當罷者罷之，更者更之，其所用人實無罪者，朕自裁決。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Let An Tong and the elder ministers deliberate on what Shirong had implemented — what should be abolished, abolish it; what should be changed, change it; as for those he employed who are truly innocent, I shall decide myself.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Let An Tong and the elder ministers deliberate on what Shirong had implemented — what should be abolished, abolish it; what should be changed, change it; as for those he employed who are truly innocent, I shall decide myself.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，敕以麥術丁所行清潔，與安童治省事。

translations.literal: " On guihai day, an order directed that Maishuding's upright conduct be combined with An Tong's administration of secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai day an order directed that Maishuding's upright conduct be combined with An Tong's administration of secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，以御史中丞郭佑為中書省參知政事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiaxu day: censor-in-chief Guo You was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiaxu day: censor-in-chief Guo You was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，減上都商稅。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, commercial taxes at Shangdu were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day commercial taxes at Shangdu were reduced.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，廣平、汴梁、鈞、鄭旱。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, drought in Guangping, Bianliang, Jun, and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day drought struck Guangping, Bianliang, Jun, and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 以遠方歷日取給京師，不以時至，荊湖等處四行省所用者隆興印之，合剌章、河西、西川等處所用者京兆印之。

translations.literal: Because almanacs for distant regions were supplied from the capital and did not arrive on time, those used by the four branch secretariats in Jinghu and elsewhere were printed at Longxing; those used in Hala Zhang, Hexi, Western Sichuan, and elsewhere were printed at Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Because almanacs for distant regions were supplied from the capital and did not arrive on time, those used by the four branch secretariats in Jinghu and elsewhere were printed at Longxing, and those used in Hala Zhang, Hexi, Western Sichuan, and elsewhere were printed at Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 詔甘州每地一頃輸稅三石。

translations.literal: An edict fixed grain tax at three shi per qing of land in Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed grain tax at three shi per qing of land in Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以軍千人修阿失鹽場倉。

translations.literal: On renwu day, one thousand troops were assigned to repair the Ashi salt-field warehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day 1,000 troops were assigned to repair the Ashi salt-field warehouse.

sentences.zh: 以忻都為踢裏玉招討使，佩虎符，有旨：「不可興兵遠攻，近地有不服者討之。

translations.literal: Xindu was made campaign commissioner of Kiril, granted a tiger tally; an order said: "Do not launch distant campaigns; pacify only those nearby who do not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Xindu was made campaign commissioner of Kiril and granted a tiger tally; an order said, "Do not launch distant campaigns; pacify only those nearby who do not submit.

sentences.zh: 」右巴等洞蠻平。

translations.literal: " The Right Ba and other cave tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: " The Right Ba and other cave tribes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立汴梁宣慰司，依安西王故事，汴梁以南至江，以親王鎮之。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the Bianliang Pacification Commission was established; following the precedent of the Prince of Anxi, from south of Bianliang to the Yangtze a princely kin was stationed to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Bianliang Pacification Commission was established; following the precedent of the Prince of Anxi, from south of Bianliang to the Yangtze a princely kin was stationed to govern it.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中書省臣言：「六部官冗甚，可止以六十八員為額，余悉汰去。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Six Ministry posts are excessively numerous; the quota should be fixed at sixty-eight, and the rest all cut.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Central Secretariat officials said, "Six Ministry posts are excessively numerous; the quota should be fixed at 68, and the rest all cut.

sentences.zh: 」詔擇其廉潔有幹局者存之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that those who were incorrupt and capable be retained.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered that those who were incorrupt and capable be retained.

translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the prefectures of Jiang, Wuding, Duolimiegai, and others were upgraded to circuits.

translations.literal: On gengyin day, silkworm disaster in Zhending, Guangping, Hejian, Enzhou, Daming, and Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day silkworm disaster struck Zhending, Guangping, Hejian, Enzhou, Daming, and Jinan.

sentences.zh: 增大都諸門尉、副各一人。

translations.literal: One additional captain and deputy captain was added at each gate of Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: One additional captain and deputy captain was added at each gate of Dadu.

sentences.zh: 敕朵兒只招集甘、沙、速等州流徙饑民。

translations.idiomatic: An order directed Doreji to gather displaced famine refugees in Gan, Sha, Su, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 行御史臺復徙於杭州。

translations.literal: The Mobile Censorate was moved back to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Mobile Censorate was moved back to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，徙行樞密院於建康。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the Mobile Privy Council was moved to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Mobile Privy Council was moved to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，汴梁、懷孟、濮州、東昌、廣平、平陽、彰德、衛輝旱。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, drought in Bianliang, Huaimeng, Puzhou, Dongchang, Guangping, Pingyang, Zhangde, and Weihui.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day drought struck Bianliang, Huaimeng, Puzhou, Dongchang, Guangping, Pingyang, Zhangde, and Weihui.

sentences.zh: 罷江南造船提舉司。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan shipbuilding intendant office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan shipbuilding intendant office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 陳日烜走海港，鎮南王命李恒追襲，敗之。

translations.literal: Chen Rihuan fled to a sea harbor; the Prince of Zhennan ordered Li Heng to pursue and attack, defeating him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Rihuan fled to a sea harbor; the Prince of Zhennan ordered Li Heng to pursue and attack, defeating him.

sentences.zh: 適暑雨疫作，兵欲北還思明州，命唆都等還烏裏。

translations.literal: As summer rains brought epidemic, the troops wished to return north to Siming Prefecture; Suodu and others were ordered back to Wuli.
translations.idiomatic: As summer rains brought epidemic, the troops wished to return north to Siming Prefecture; Suodu and others were ordered back to Wuli.

sentences.zh: 安南以兵追躡，唆都戰死；

translations.literal: Annam pursued with troops, and Suodu died in battle;
translations.idiomatic: Annam pursued with troops, and Suodu died in battle;

sentences.zh: 恒為後距，以衛鎮南王，藥矢中左膝，至思明，毒發而卒。

translations.literal: Heng brought up the rear to protect the Prince of Zhennan; struck by a poisoned arrow in the left knee, he reached Siming, where the poison took effect and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Heng brought up the rear to protect the Prince of Zhennan; struck by a poisoned arrow in the left knee, he reached Siming, where the poison took effect and he died.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，命女直、水達達造船二百艘及造征日本迎風船。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengxu day: the Jurchen and Suiyede were ordered to build two hundred ships and Japan-expedition wind-facing vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengxu day: the Jurchen and Suiyede were ordered to build 200 ships and Japan-expedition wind-facing vessels.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，揚州進芝草。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Yangzhou presented auspicious lingzhi fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yangzhou presented auspicious lingzhi fungus.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣馬速忽、阿裏賫鈔千錠往馬八圖求奇寶，賜馬速忽虎符，阿裏金符。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Masuhu and Ali were dispatched with one thousand ingots of notes to Mabatu to seek rare treasures; Masuhu was granted a tiger tally and Ali a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Masuhu and Ali were dispatched with 1,000 ingots of notes to Mabatu to seek rare treasures; Masuhu was granted a tiger tally and Ali a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使來貢方物。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔減商稅，罷牙行，省市舶司入轉運司。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict reduced commercial taxes, abolished broker houses, and merged the maritime trade office into the transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict reduced commercial taxes, abolished broker houses, and merged the maritime trade office into the transport commission.

translations.idiomatic: Left vice chancellor Lü Shiqing requested five months' leave to visit his mother in Jiangzhou; the Emperor granted it and said to An Tong, "You Mongols would not know of such matters; I have no Han Chinese close at hand either — approval or refusal is all my own decision.

sentences.zh: 汝當盡心善治百姓，無使重困致亂，以為朕羞。

translations.literal: You must devote yourselves wholeheartedly to governing the people well, and not let them be heavily burdened into rebellion, to my shame.
translations.idiomatic: You must devote yourselves wholeheartedly to governing the people well and not let them be heavily burdened into rebellion, to my shame.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事張德潤獻其家人四百戶於皇太子。

translations.idiomatic: " Associate administrator Zhang Derun presented his 400 household dependents to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 馬湖部田鼠食稼殆盡，其總管祠而祝之，鼠悉赴水死。

translations.literal: Field mice in the Mahu department ate the crops nearly to extinction; its commissioner prayed at a shrine, and all the mice went into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: Field mice in the Mahu department ate the crops nearly to extinction; its commissioner prayed at a shrine, and all the mice went into the water and died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，造溫石浴室及更衣殿。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renshen day: warm-stone bathhouses and changing halls were constructed.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, renshen day: warm-stone bathhouses and changing halls were constructed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔禁捕獵。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, an edict forbade hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict forbade hunting.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，敕秘書監修《地理志》。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, an order directed the Secretariat Directorate to compile the Geographic Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an order directed the Secretariat Directorate to compile the Geographic Treatise.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，安南降者昭國王、武道、文義、彰憲、彰懷四侯赴闕。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the surrendered Annam officials Prince Zhao and the four marquises Wudao, Wanyi, Zhangxian, and Zhanghuai came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the surrendered Annam officials Prince Zhao and the four marquises Wudao, Wanyi, Zhangxian, and Zhanghuai came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，京師蝗。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, locusts in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day locusts struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 分甘州屯田新附軍三百人，田於亦集乃之地。

translations.literal: Three hundred newly submitted garrison-farming troops of Ganzhou were divided off to farm in Yijinai.
translations.idiomatic: 300 newly submitted garrison-farming troops of Ganzhou were divided off to farm in Yijinai.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以米千石廩甕吉剌貧民。

translations.literal: On jimao day, one thousand shi of rice was issued from the granary to the poor of Onggirat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day 1,000 shi of rice was issued from the granary to the poor of Onggirat.

sentences.zh: 壬午，陜西四川行中書省左丞汪惟正入見。

translations.literal: On renwu day, left vice chancellor Wang Weizheng of the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat had an audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day left vice chancellor Wang Weizheng of the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat had an audience.

sentences.zh: 甲申，改闊裏吉思等所平大小十溪洞悉為府、州、縣。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the great and small ten cave tribes pacified by Kölügis and others were reorganized into prefectures, subprefectures, and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the great and small ten cave tribes pacified by Kölügis and others were reorganized into prefectures, subprefectures, and counties.

sentences.zh: 修汴梁城。

translations.literal: The walls of Bianliang were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The walls of Bianliang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，廣東宣慰使月的迷失入覲，以所降渠帥郭逢貴等至京師，言山寨降者百五十餘所。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedimishi had an audience; with the surrendered chieftains Guo Fenggui and others he arrived at the capital and reported that more than one hundred fifty mountain stockades had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedimishi had an audience; with the surrendered chieftains Guo Fenggui and others he arrived at the capital and reported that more than 150 mountain stockades had submitted.

sentences.zh: 帝問：「戰而後降邪，招之即降邪？

translations.literal: The Emperor asked: "Did they submit only after fighting, or did they submit as soon as summoned?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked, "Did they submit only after fighting, or did they submit as soon as summoned?

sentences.zh: 」月的迷失對曰：「其首拒敵者臣已磔之矣，是皆招降者也。

translations.idiomatic: " Yuedimishi replied, "Those chiefs who resisted I have already quartered; the rest all submitted when summoned.

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Privy Council said, "The troops campaigning against Jiaozhi under Prince of Zhennan Tuohan have fought long and are exhausted; request 1,000 Mongol troops from 30,000 orlu households of Orluchi and others, and 4,000 Han and newly submitted troops from the Jianghuai, Jiangxi, and Jinghu mobile armies; select good generals to lead them under Prince Tuohan and Ala Haiya to campaign against Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 復以唐兀帶為荊湖行省左丞。

translations.idiomatic: Tangudai was again made left vice chancellor of the Jinghu Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 唐兀帶請放征交趾軍還家休憩，詔從脫歡、阿裏海牙處之。

translations.idiomatic: Tangudai requested that the Jiaozhi expedition troops be released home to rest; an edict ordered this handled by Tuohan and Ala Haiya.

sentences.zh: 給諸王阿只吉分地貧民農具牛種，令自耕播。

translations.idiomatic: Farming tools, oxen, and seed were granted to the poor of Prince Ajigi's appanage to sow and cultivate on their own.
