translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Yunnan branch secretariat said, "This year we cannot yet campaign against Burma; after the autumn harvest, please first attack the Luobeidian and other tribes.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the three prefectures of Kai, Da, and Liangshan were made subordinate to Kuizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the three prefectures of Kai, Da, and Liangshan were made subordinate to Kuizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 給鈔萬二千四百錠為本，取息以贍甘、肅二州屯田貧軍。

translations.literal: Twelve thousand four hundred ingots of notes were granted as capital; interest was to sustain the impoverished garrison-farming troops of Gan and Su prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: 12,400 ingots of notes were granted as capital; interest was to sustain the impoverished garrison-farming troops of Gan and Su prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，命有司祭鬥三日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinyou day: officials were ordered to sacrifice to the Dipper for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinyou day: officials were ordered to sacrifice to the Dipper for three days.

sentences.zh: 戊申，分四川鎮守軍萬人屯田成都。

translations.literal: On wushen day, ten thousand Sichuan garrison troops were divided off to garrison-farm at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day 10,000 Sichuan garrison troops were divided off to garrison-farm at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔復立泉府司，秩從二品，以答失蠻領之。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, an edict restored the Currency Commission, rank 2b, with Dashman in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict restored the Currency Commission, rank 2b, with Dashman in charge.

sentences.zh: 初，和禮霍孫以泉府司商販者，所至官給飲食，遣兵防衛，民實厭苦不便，奏罷之。

translations.literal: Initially, Helü Huosun had argued that the Currency Commission's merchants were supplied food and drink and given military escorts wherever they went, which truly burdened and inconvenienced the people; he memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Helü Huosun had argued that the Currency Commission's merchants were supplied food and drink and given military escorts wherever they went, which truly burdened and inconvenienced the people; he memorialized to abolish it.

sentences.zh: 至是，答失蠻復奏立之。

translations.literal: At this time Dashman again memorialized to restore it.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Dashman again memorialized to restore it.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣蒙古軍三千人屯田清、滄、靖海。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, three thousand Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Qing, Cang, and Jinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day 3,000 Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Qing, Cang, and Jinghai.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷禁海商。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the ban on maritime merchants was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the ban on maritime merchants was lifted.

sentences.zh: 省合剌章、金齒二宣撫司為一，治永昌。

translations.literal: The Hala Zhang and Jinchi pacification commissions were merged into one, based at Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: The Hala Zhang and Jinchi pacification commissions were merged into one, based at Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 立臨安廣西道宣撫司。

translations.literal: The Lin'an Guangxi Circuit Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Lin'an Guangxi Circuit Pacification Commission was established.

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials memorialized: "We were recently ordered to register Jianghuai boatmen; all Jianghuai people can swim, and we fear many will be disturbed by this.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials memorialized, "We were recently ordered to register Jianghuai boatmen; all Jianghuai people can swim, and we fear many will be disturbed by this.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 罷榷酤。

translations.literal: The wine monopoly was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The wine monopoly was abolished.

sentences.zh: 初，民間酒聽自造，米一石官取鈔一貫。

translations.literal: Initially private brewing was permitted; one shi of rice yielded one ingot in tax.
translations.idiomatic: Initially private brewing was permitted; one shi of rice yielded one ingot in tax.

sentences.zh: 盧世榮以官鈔五萬錠立榷酤法，米一石取鈔十貫，增舊十倍。

translations.literal: Lu Shirong established a monopoly with fifty thousand ingots of official notes as capital; one shi of rice yielded ten ingots in tax, ten times the former rate.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong established a monopoly with 50,000 ingots of official notes as capital; one shi of rice yielded 10 ingots in tax, ten times the former rate.

sentences.zh: 至是罷榷酤，聽民自造，增課鈔一貫為五貫。

translations.literal: At this time the monopoly was abolished, private brewing permitted again, and the tax increased from one to five ingots per shi.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the monopoly was abolished, private brewing was permitted again, and the tax increased from one to five ingots per shi.

sentences.zh: 敕拘銅錢，余銅器聽民仍用。

translations.literal: An order directed seizure of copper coins; other copper vessels the people were permitted to keep using.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed seizure of copper coins; other copper vessels the people were permitted to keep using.

translations.idiomatic: In Fujian, Huanghua She troops with fixed property were made commoners; those without fixed property or with wife and children were enrolled as city-garrison troops.

translations.literal: Wang Weizheng said that garrison troops, relay households, and various people's slaves and maidservants who during famine years had fled into Shaanxi and Sichuan were there immediately registered as army relays.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Weizheng said that garrison troops, relay households, and various people's slaves and maidservants who during famine years had fled into Shaanxi and Sichuan were there immediately registered as army relays.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「信如所言，當鳩集與之，如非己有而強欲得之者，豈彼於法不懼邪？」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If it is truly as you say, they should be gathered and returned; if someone not the owner forcibly tries to take them, would those people not fear the law?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "If it is truly as you say, they should be gathered and returned; if someone not the owner forcibly tries to take them, would those people not fear the law?"

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，聽民自實兩淮荒地，免稅三年。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yihai day: the people were permitted to register and reclaim wasteland in the Two Huai regions, tax-free for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yihai day: the people were permitted to register and reclaim wasteland in the Two Huai regions, tax-free for three years.

translations.idiomatic: An order said, "From now on tribute shall be only what each region produces; what is not produced locally must not be submitted.

translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi day Chenla and Champa presented 10 musicians and medicinal materials, crocodile skins, and other goods.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day craftsmen in hiding were rounded up.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day envoys from Samudra and Ma'dha came to court.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雲南貢方物。

translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Yunnan presented local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙叛，命四川行院也速帶兒將兵討之，馬湖總管汝作以蠻軍三百為助。

translations.idiomatic: Wumeng rebelled; Yesudai'er of the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to lead troops against them, with Ma Hu prefectural magistrate Ruzuo supplying 300 tribal troops.

sentences.zh: 降西崖門酋長阿者等百餘戶。

translations.literal: Over one hundred households under Xiyamen chief Aze and others submitted.
translations.idiomatic: More than 100 households under Xiyamen chief Aze and others submitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，以鈔五千錠和糴於應昌府。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jihai day five thousand ingots of paper currency were used for equitable purchase of grain at Yingchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jihai day 5,000 ingots of paper currency were used to purchase grain equitably at Yingchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復分河間、山東鹽課轉運司為二。

translations.idiomatic: The Hejian and Shandong salt tax transport commissions were again divided in two.

sentences.zh: 遣合撒兒海牙使安南。

translations.literal: Hesen Haiya was dispatched as envoy to Annam.
translations.idiomatic: Hesen Haiya was dispatched as envoy to Annam.

sentences.zh: 遣雪雪的斤領畏兀兒戶一千戍合剌章。

translations.literal: Xuexuedejin was dispatched to lead one thousand Uighur households to garrison Helazhang.
translations.idiomatic: Xuexuedejin was dispatched to lead 1,000 Uighur households to garrison Helazhang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengzi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，修南嶽廟。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the Southern Peak Temple was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Southern Peak Temple was repaired.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，樞密院臣言：「脫脫木兒遣使言，阿沙、阿女、阿則三部欲叛，宜遣人往召，如不至，乘隙伐之。

translations.literal: On yisi day Privy Council officials said: "Tuotuomu'er sent a messenger saying the three divisions of Asha, Anü, and Aze wish to rebel; envoys should be sent to summon them, and if they do not come, attack when an opportunity arises.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day privy council officials said, "Tuotuomu'er sent word that the Asha, Anü, and Aze divisions wished to rebel; envoys should summon them, and if they did not come, attack when an opportunity arose.

sentences.zh: 」不允，因敕諭之：「事不議於雲南王也先帖木兒者，毋輒行。

translations.idiomatic: " The request was denied, and an edict instructed them, "Matters not deliberated with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur must not be carried out on one's own.

sentences.zh: 」詔征東招討使塔塔兒帶、揚兀魯帶以萬人征骨嵬，因授揚兀魯帶三珠虎符，為征東宣慰使都元帥。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Eastern Campaign pacification commissioners Tatardai and Yang Uludai to lead ten thousand men against Guwei; Yang Uludai was granted a triple-pearl tiger tally and made Eastern Campaign pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Eastern Campaign pacification commissioners Tatardai and Yang Uludai to lead 10,000 men against Guwei; Yang Uludai received a triple-pearl tiger tally and was made Eastern Campaign pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，長葛、郾城各進芝草。

translations.literal: On renzi day Changge and Yancheng each presented auspicious fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Changge and Yancheng each presented auspicious fungus.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立征東行省，以阿塔海為左丞相，劉國傑、陳巖並左丞，洪茶丘右丞，征日本。

translations.literal: On guichou day the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat was established; Atahai was made left grand councillor, Liu Guojie and Chen Yan were both left vice councillors, Hong Chachiu was right vice councillor, to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was established; Atahai was made left grand councillor, Liu Guojie and Chen Yan were both left vice councillors, Hong Chachiu was right vice councillor, to campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 賜脫裏察安、答即古阿散等印，令考核中書省，其制如三品。

translations.literal: Seals were granted to Tuolichaan, Dajiguasan, and others, ordering them to audit the Central Secretariat, with rank equivalent to rank three.
translations.idiomatic: Seals were granted to Tuolichaan, Dajiguasan, and others to audit the Central Secretariat at rank equivalent to grade three.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以參議帖木兒為參知政事，位郭佑上，且命之曰：「自今之事，皆責於汝。

translations.literal: On bingchen day councilor Timur was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, ranking above Guo You, and he was charged: "From now on all affairs are your responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day councilor Timur was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, ranking above Guo You, and charged, "From now on all affairs are your responsibility.

sentences.zh: 」馬法國入貢。

translations.literal: " The Kingdom of Ma-fa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " The Kingdom of Ma-fa sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以江淮行省平章忙兀帶為江浙省左丞相。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat grand councillor Mangudai was made left grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jiang-Huai branch secretariat grand councillor Mangudai was made left grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 初，西川止立四路，阿合馬濫用官，增而為九，臺臣言其地民少，留廣元、成都、順慶、重慶、夔府五路，余悉罷去。

translations.literal: Initially Western Sichuan had only four circuits; Ahmad had abusively expanded offices to nine; censorial officials said the region had few people — Guangyuan, Chengdu, Shunqing, Chongqing, and Kuizhou circuits were retained, and the rest were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Western Sichuan had only four circuits; Ahmad had abusively expanded offices to nine; censorial officials said the region had too few people — Guangyuan, Chengdu, Shunqing, Chongqing, and Kuizhou were retained and the rest abolished.

sentences.zh: 後以山谷險要，蠻夷雜處，復置嘉定路、敘州宣撫司以控制之。

translations.literal: Later, because of the strategic mountain valleys and mixed barbarian settlement, Jiading Route and Xuzhou Pacification Commission were re-established to control the area.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because of strategic valleys and mixed barbarian settlement, Jiading Route and the Xuzhou pacification commission were re-established to control the area.

sentences.zh: 升大理寺為都護府，職從二品。

translations.literal: The Court of Review was promoted to the Office of the Chief Defender of Justice, rank two subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Review was promoted to the Office of the Chief Defender of Justice at subordinate rank two.

sentences.zh: 都護府言合剌禾州民饑，戶給牛二頭、種二石，更給鈔一十一萬六千四百錠，糴米六萬四百石，為四月糧賑之。

translations.literal: The Chief Defender's Office reported that the people of Helahe Prefecture were starving; each household was given two oxen and two shi of seed grain, and additionally one hundred sixteen thousand four hundred ingots of paper currency to purchase sixty thousand four hundred shi of rice as four months' famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Defender's Office reported famine in Helahe Prefecture; each household received two oxen and two shi of seed grain, plus 116,400 ingots of paper currency to buy 60,400 shi of rice as four months' relief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以答即古阿散理算積年錢谷，別置司署，與省部敵，干擾政務，並入省中。

translations.literal: On guihai day because Dajiguasan's audit of accumulated years' revenue and grain had set up a separate agency at odds with the secretariat departments, disturbing government affairs, it was merged into the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Dajiguasan's audit of accumulated revenue and grain, which had set up a separate agency at odds with the secretariat and disturbed government affairs, was merged back into the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，敕樞密院計膠、萊諸處漕船，高麗、江南諸處所造海舶，括傭江淮民船，備征日本。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Privy Council was ordered to account for transport ships at Jiao, Lai, and other places, sea vessels built in Goryeo and Jiangnan, and requisition hired civilian ships from Jiang-Huai, to prepare for the Japan expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the privy council was ordered to account for transport ships at Jiao, Lai, and elsewhere, sea vessels built in Goryeo and Jiangnan, and requisitioned civilian ships from Jiang-Huai for the Japan expedition.

sentences.zh: 仍敕習泛海者，募水工至千人者為千戶，百人為百戶。

translations.idiomatic: It was further ordered that those trained in open-sea sailing should recruit sailors — groups of 1,000 to be qianhu and groups of 100 to be baihu.

translations.idiomatic: Ta Hai's younger brother Liushi said, "Commoners and peoples of various appanages are all ordered to build ships in Jurchen territory while Jurchen are again conscripted as soldiers — corvée labor is extremely heavy.

sentences.zh: 乃顏、勝納合兒兩投下鷹坊、采金等戶獨不調。

translations.literal: The eagle-hunting and gold-mining households of the appanages of Nayan and Shennahe'er alone are not being levied.
translations.idiomatic: The eagle-hunting and gold-mining households of the appanages of Nayan and Shennahe'er alone are not being levied.

sentences.zh: 」有旨遣使發其民。

translations.literal: " An imperial instruction ordered envoys dispatched to levy their people.
translations.idiomatic: " An imperial instruction ordered envoys dispatched to levy their people.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙蠻夷宣撫使阿蒙叛，詔止征羅必丹兵，同雲南行省出兵討之。

translations.literal: Wumeng tribal pacification commissioner Ameng rebelled; an edict halted the campaign against Luobidan troops and ordered the Yunnan Branch Secretariat to join in dispatching troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng tribal pacification commissioner Ameng rebelled; an edict halted the Luobidan campaign and ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to join in suppressing him.

translations.idiomatic: Guo You said, "Since the pacification of Jiangnan, revenue and grain affairs have been audited eight times in ten years.

translations.idiomatic: Now Dajiguasan and others are auditing again; they should be dismissed immediately.

translations.literal: " The emperor commendably accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor commendably accepted this.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the jisi new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedeshimi said the three circuits of Yingde, Xun, and Mei had few people and asked they be changed to prefectures; he also asked that garrison commander Yuyue be made Huizhou zongguan and Weizhou prefectural magistrate Mubala be made Chaozhou darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jisi new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedeshimi said Yingde, Xun, and Mei circuits had too few people and asked they be changed to prefectures; he also asked garrison commander Yuyue be made Huizhou zongguan and Weizhou prefect Mubala be made Chaozhou darughachi.

sentences.zh: 帝疑其專，不允。

translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected him of acting arbitrarily and denied the request.

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "The Censorate and Surveillance Commissions have the duty of investigating officials; recently those auditing revenue and grain fear exposure of their wrongdoing and have privately gathered unruly elements to obstruct the work — we ask Your Majesty to instruct them according to the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "The censorate and surveillance commissions exist to investigate officials; those now auditing revenue and grain fear exposure of their wrongdoing and have gathered unruly elements to obstruct the work — we ask Your Majesty to instruct them according to the old regulations.

translations.idiomatic: " The edict said, "Approved.

translations.idiomatic: " On gengwu day Prince Ayachi was granted a silver seal.

translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, for the campaign against Japan, Abachi was dispatched to oversee Jiang-Huai branch secretariat military supplies and Chahu to oversee Liaodong branch secretariat military supplies.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day relay stations were established at Helazhang, Sichuan, Jiandu, and elsewhere.

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys informed Goryeo to raise 10,000 troops and 650 ships for the Japan expedition and to build more ships nearby.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou day 123 households of the Bufahua family in Chongqing Prefecture were registered as commoners.

translations.literal: Censorate officials memorialized: "Formerly the Song enlisted unmarried strong men as salt troops, totaling five thousand; today one thousand one hundred twenty-two remain, habitually violent, causing the people great suffering — they should be given clothing and grain and made to garrison-farm for self-support.

sentences.zh: 」詔議行之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.

translations.literal: On guisi day an edict ordered one million shi of Jiang-Huai grain transported by canal, shipped by sea, and stored at Hap'o in Goryeo; Tokyo and Goryeo were each also ordered to store one hundred thousand shi for the Japan expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered 1 million shi of Jiang-Huai grain transported by canal and sea to Hap'o in Goryeo; Tokyo and Goryeo were each also to store 100,000 shi for the Japan expedition.

sentences.zh: 諸軍期於明年三月以次而發，八月會於合浦。

translations.literal: All armies were scheduled to depart in sequence starting the third month of next year and assemble at Hap'o in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: All armies were to depart in sequence from the third month of the next year and assemble at Hap'o in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以禿魯歡為參知政事，盧世榮伏誅。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Tulughuan was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, and Lu Shirong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Tulughuan was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat and Lu Shirong was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，赦囚徒，黥其面，及招宋時販私鹽軍習海道者為水工，以征日本。

translations.literal: On bingshen day prisoners were pardoned, their faces tattooed, and Song-era private salt smuggling troops skilled in sea routes were recruited as sailors for the Japan expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day prisoners were pardoned and tattooed, and Song-era private salt smugglers skilled at sea routes were recruited as sailors for the Japan expedition.

sentences.zh: 十二月，敕減天下罪囚。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, an edict reduced sentences of prisoners throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict reduced sentences of prisoners throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以占城遁還忽都虎、劉九、田二復舊職，從征日本。

translations.idiomatic: Because they had fled back from Champa, Huduhu, Liu Jiu, and Tian Er were restored to their former posts for the Japan expedition.

sentences.zh: 增阿塔海征日本戰士萬人、回回炮手五十人。

translations.idiomatic: 10,000 additional campaign troops and 50 Muslim catapult specialists were added to Atahai's Japan expedition force.

sentences.zh: 己亥，從樞密院請，嚴立軍籍條例，選壯士及有力家充軍。

translations.literal: On jihai day, acceding to the Privy Council's request, military register regulations were strictly established and strong men and powerful households were selected for military service.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, acceding to the privy council's request, military register regulations were strictly established and strong men and powerful households were selected for service.

translations.idiomatic: An edict to the privy council said, "Formerly the Five Guard armies were sent home to prepare equipment for the Japan expedition; now select strong men in full to reach the capital by the first day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 」江淮行省以戰船千艘習水戰江中。

translations.literal: " The Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat drilled naval combat on the river with one thousand warships.
translations.idiomatic: " The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat drilled naval combat on the river with 1,000 warships.

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Dajiguasan's associates Cai Zhongying and Li Xi were executed.

translations.literal: On dingwei day the crown prince died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the crown prince died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以中衛軍四千人伐木五萬八千六百，給萬安寺修造。

translations.literal: On wuwu day four thousand Central Guard troops felled fifty-eight thousand six hundred trees for repairs at Wan'an Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day 4,000 Central Guard troops felled 58,600 trees for repairs at Wan'an Temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，丹太廟楹。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the pillars of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were painted red.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the pillars of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were painted red.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立集賢院，以劄裏蠻領之。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Academy of Gathered Worthies was established, with Jariman placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Academy of Gathered Worthies was established under Jariman.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷合剌章打金規運所及都元帥。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Helazhang gold-washing supervision office and commander-in-chief post were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Helazhang gold-washing supervision office and commander-in-chief post were abolished.

sentences.zh: 敕合剌章酋長之子入質京師，千戶、百戶子留質雲南王也先帖木兒所。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Helazhang chiefs' sons sent as hostages to the capital, and qianhu and baihu sons left as hostages with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Helazhang chiefs' sons sent as hostages to the capital and qianhu and baihu sons left as hostages with Prince of Yunnan Yesun Temur.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣奏：「納速丁言，減合剌章冗官，可歲省俸金九百四十六兩；

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials memorialized: "Nasuding said reducing superfluous Helazhang officials could save nine hundred forty-six liang of salary gold annually;
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials memorialized, "Nasuding said reducing superfluous Helazhang officials could save 946 liang of salary gold annually;

sentences.zh: 又屯田課程專人主之，可歲得金五千兩。

translations.literal: and appointing dedicated overseers of garrison-farm revenue could yield five thousand liang of gold annually.
translations.idiomatic: and appointing dedicated overseers of garrison-farm revenue could yield 5,000 liang of gold annually.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " All were approved.

sentences.zh: 遣只必哥等考核雲南行省。

translations.literal: Zhibige and others were dispatched to audit the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhibige and others were dispatched to audit the Yunnan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔毋遷轉工匠官。

translations.literal: On gengyin day an edict forbade transfer and rotation of artisan officials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict forbade transfer and rotation of artisan officials.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，敕有司祭北斗。

translations.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered the relevant offices to sacrifice to the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered the relevant offices to sacrifice to the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 是歲，命江浙轉運司通管課程。

translations.literal: That year the Jiang-Zhe Transport Commission was ordered to administer all tax items comprehensively.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jiang-Zhe transport commission was ordered to administer all tax items comprehensively.

sentences.zh: 集諸路僧四萬於西京普恩寺，作資戒會七日夜。

translations.literal: Forty thousand monks from all routes were gathered at Pu'en Temple in the Western Capital for a seven-night ordination assembly.
translations.idiomatic: 40,000 monks from all routes were gathered at Pu'en Temple in the Western Capital for a seven-night ordination assembly.

sentences.zh: 並省重慶等處州縣。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties at Chongqing and elsewhere were consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties at Chongqing and elsewhere were consolidated.

sentences.zh: 占城行省參政亦黑迷失等以軍還，駐海外四州，遣使以聞，敕放其軍還。

translations.literal: Champa Branch Secretariat associate administrator Yiqihumishi and others, returning with the army, were stationed at four overseas prefectures; they sent messengers to report, and an edict released their army to return.
translations.idiomatic: Champa branch secretariat associate administrator Yiqihumishi and others, returning with the army, were stationed at four overseas prefectures; they sent messengers to report, and an edict released their army to return.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子脫歡，諸王阿魯灰、只吉不花，公主囊家真等，鈔計七千七百三十二錠、馬六百二十九匹、衣段百匹、弓千、矢二萬發。

translations.literal: Prince Tuohuan, princes Arugui, Jijibuhua, Princess Nangiazhen, and others were granted a total of seven thousand seven hundred thirty-two ingots of paper currency, six hundred twenty-nine horses, one hundred bolts of cloth, one thousand bows, and twenty thousand arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan, princes Arugui and Jijibuhua, Princess Nangiazhen, and others received 7,732 ingots of paper currency, 629 horses, 100 bolts of cloth, 1,000 bows, and 20,000 arrows.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王阿只吉、合兒魯、忙兀帶、宋忽兒、阿沙、合丹、別合剌等及官戶散居河西者，羊馬價鈔三萬七千七百五十七錠、布四千匹、絹二千匹。

translations.literal: Princes Azhiji, Hé'erlu, Mangudai, Songhu'er, Asha, Hedan, Biehela, and others, and official households scattered in Hexi, were granted thirty-seven thousand seven hundred fifty-seven ingots of paper currency as price for sheep and horses, four thousand bolts of cloth, and two thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Azhiji, Hé'erlu, Mangudai, Songhu'er, Asha, Hedan, Biehela, and others, and official households scattered in Hexi, received 37,757 ingots of paper currency as price for sheep and horses, 4,000 bolts of cloth, and 2,000 bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 以伯八剌等貧乏，給鈔七萬六千五百二錠。

translations.literal: Because Bapala and others were impoverished, seventy-six thousand five hundred two ingots of paper currency were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Bapala and others were impoverished, 76,502 ingots of paper currency were granted.

sentences.zh: 賞諸王阿只吉、小廝、汪總帥、別速帶、也先等所部及征緬、占城等軍，鈔五萬三千五百四十一錠、馬八千一百九十七匹、羊一萬六千六百三十四、牛十一、米二萬二千一百石、絹帛八萬一千匹、綿五百三十斤、木綿二萬七千二百七十九匹、甲千被、弓千張、衣百七十九襲。

translations.literal: Princes Azhiji, Xiaosi, Commander Wang, Biesudai, Yesun, and others, and the armies campaigning against Burma and Champa, were rewarded with fifty-three thousand five hundred forty-one ingots of paper currency, eight thousand one hundred ninety-seven horses, sixteen thousand six hundred thirty-four sheep, eleven oxen, twenty-two thousand one hundred shi of rice, eighty-one thousand bolts of silk cloth, five hundred thirty jin of cotton, twenty-seven thousand two hundred seventy-nine bolts of cotton cloth, one thousand suits of armor and bedding, one thousand bows, and one hundred seventy-nine sets of clothing.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Azhiji, Xiaosi, Commander Wang, Biesudai, Yesun, and others, and the Burma and Champa campaign armies, were rewarded with 53,541 ingots of paper currency, 8,197 horses, 16,634 sheep, 11 oxen, 22,100 shi of rice, 81,000 bolts of silk cloth, 530 jin of cotton, 27,279 bolts of cotton cloth, 1,000 suits of armor and bedding, 1,000 bows, and 179 sets of clothing.

sentences.zh: 命帝師也憐八合失甲自羅二思八等遞藏佛事於萬安、興教、慶壽等寺，凡一十九會。

translations.literal: The Imperial Preceptor Yelianbaheshili, Luosi'erba, and others were ordered to conduct Tibetan Buddhist rites in rotation at Wan'an, Xingjiao, Qingshou, and other temples, nineteen assemblies in all.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial preceptor Yelianbaheshili, Luosi'erba, and others were ordered to conduct Tibetan Buddhist rites in rotation at Wan'an, Xingjiao, Qingshou, and other temples — 19 assemblies in all.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪二百七十一人。

translations.literal: Two hundred seventy-one persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: 271 persons were sentenced to death.
